clips.title: The story
paras: Viscous Fallout is a toxic water elemental wandering the irradiated corridors of Gnomeregan, a living mass of the poison that fouled the city after Mekgineer Thermaplugg's devastating radiation release.

When Gnomeregan was flooded with radiation on Mekgineer Thermaplugg's treacherous advice to wipe out the invading troggs, the fallout left the city's lower levels awash in toxic slime and contamination. Viscous Fallout is a water elemental of that poisoned depth, its very substance thick with the city's toxic waste. Where it came from before the fall is not known.
